content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully functional online store without relying on Stripe or PayPal. By using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, you can deploy your site quickly and efficiently. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing for seamless transactions. This infrastructure not only empowers you to launch your store but also ensures that you retain full ownership of your data and products. The process is straightforward, and you can start selling within 48 hours.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is your best option for getting started quickly. For just $97, you can have a complete setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, integrated with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. This stack allows you to load three products and comes with 30 days of support to ensure everything runs smoothly. By leveraging this infrastructure, you can also explore alternative cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on deploying your store and accepting payments rather than getting caught up in unnecessary complexities. You don’t need to worry about building a custom backend at this stage; instead, utilize the tools available through the Sovereign Starter Stack. Skip concerns about marketing initially; your priority should be ensuring that your payment system is operational. Once your store is live and transactions are flowing, you can refine your marketing approach and enhance your offerings.
Your customers can pay with over 300 cryptocurrencies — no restrictions.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To make your first transaction, start by creating a product and uploading it to your store. Then, integrate NOWPayments for instant crypto payment verification. Be sure to promote your product through social media channels and leverage Binance P2P to convert your local currency into crypto if needed. The moment a customer makes a purchase, you will receive automatic verification, and your digital product can be delivered immediately. This streamlined process ensures a frictionless transaction experience for you and your customers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, your action plan should include setting up your online store, loading your first three products, and integrating NOWPayments. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the blueprints and templates necessary for scaling your digital commerce stack. Engage with your audience on social media to create awareness for your products and encourage early sales. Begin accepting payments without barriers and build your customer base.

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by leveraging blockchain payment solutions like NOWPayments. This allows for transactions without the need for conventional payment platforms, enabling seamless access to global markets. By adopting infrastructure like the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can get set up quickly and retain full ownership of your data.
Instant payment verification means you deliver products immediately upon purchase.

For those looking to deepen their understanding of this infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers comprehensive blueprints and templates to build and scale your online store. This resource can be a game-changer for creators aiming to optimize their digital product sales without relying on traditional payment systems.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
